### 🎯 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or operational bottleneck is (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when...*).

### 🚀 Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include API contracts, UI concepts, or workflow diagrams if applicable.

### 🔍 Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, third-party libraries, or workarounds you've considered.

### 📦 Target Area
- [ ] Telephony / Voice Pipeline (Amazon Connect, SIP, WebRTC)
- [ ] Agent Reasoning & Tool Execution (Groq, LLM Prompts, Tools)
- [ ] Multi-Tenant Data & Storage (PostgreSQL, SQLite, Supabase RLS)
- [ ] Dashboard & UI/UX (Next.js, Analytics, Web Simulator)
- [ ] Worker & Durable Execution (Outbox, Leases, Retries)
- [ ] Integrations (Google Sheets, SMS, Email, CRM)

### 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, customer stories, or screenshots about the feature request here.
